'''Ken-La Outpost''' was an outpost of the [[Voss commandos]] in the [[Old Paths]] region of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]]. The [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] also maintained a significant presence there, basing most of its operations in the region at the outpost.
